scope: Neural-only preregistered screen of three bounded block-conductance scalars applied to EXISTING strict edges of the frozen 20k module. No physics, no readout learning, no acceptance change, no new edges, no external oscillator, no descending drive.
why: Round 11 established that the frozen module's leg activity is bilaterally symmetric (PC1 49.5% variance, loadings LF +.58 RF +.70 LH -.31 RH -.28, left/right near equal) with no tripod anti-phase (LF-RH .036, RF-LH .082), that scaling motor-neuron adaptation cannot change inter-leg coupling because all 323 MNs are strict graph sinks, and that the tripod partner coupling does exist structurally but is only 11.08% of the same-row contralateral class. The natural next test is therefore whether re-weighting EXISTING leg-pair edge classes can push the module into anti-phase.
mechanism: module_blocks.py rebuilds the strict excitatory/inhibitory matrices from the frozen source arrays exactly as the frozen 192931Z core does, except each edge's raw synapse count is multiplied by the scalar of its leg-pair class, and each postsynaptic row is then renormalised to the frozen 0.020 uS total (proposal V1). With all scalars 1 this must reproduce the frozen matrices and the frozen network behaviour bit-exactly, which is checked before the grid.

grid.rule: complete factorial, every combination run and reported; no pruning by intermediate score

protocol: Restore the canonical 2000-step state before every run; feed the recorded 100 sensory bins cyclically for 400 bins (2000 ms) with zero descending current; record every 5 ms bin the 323 exported MN filtered rates. Physical steps 0.
fixed_analysis: Per leg mean rate; tripod alternation score = -corr(mean(LF,RM,LH), mean(RF,LM,RH)); ipsilateral score = corr(left triple, right triple); LF-RH and RF-LH pair correlations; per-leg mean rates; PCA of the six leg-rate series (variance fractions and loadings). Identical to the round-11 intrinsic analysis so numbers are comparable.
decision_rule_fixed_in_advance: A combination is ALTERNATION-POSITIVE only if tripod score >= 0.30, both tripod-group mean rates > 2 Hz, and both LF-RH and RF-LH correlations are negative. A positive result licenses only a further preregistered physical experiment with readout learning; it is not walking and not a biological claim. All-negative is a valid published result and must not be reframed as partial success.
expected_headroom_from_structure: leg-pools computed that s_tripod_diagonal = 4.0 raises that class only to 0.5393 uS (44.33% of the frozen same-row contralateral class) and touches only 114 target neurons, so a negative outcome is anticipated and is informative about mechanism rather than about the fly.
limits: Open-loop neural replay with recorded sensory currents: no contact, no sensorimotor loop, no body. Scalars are uncalibrated engineering weights, not measured synaptic strengths; the strict 20k subgraph is not the whole VNC; receptor signs remain illustrative. Nothing here is a lesion, a surgical model, or evidence that the animal lacks any mechanism.
